verdict.rationale: There is no explicit user-initiated bulk-operation feature, such as selecting many PRs or findings and acting on them together. The closest evidence is scale-wide automation: automatic reviews on every PR update and on all PRs, plus organization-wide rules set once in Bugbot Automations that apply across repositories. Manual triggers work per PR via comment only. Missing for 10: explicit bulk actions (batch-triggering reviews across many PRs, bulk-resolving or dismissing findings, bulk 'fix' across issues), an API or CLI for batch operations, and independent corroboration.
